note: Test-id ledger for GF-3 T2 (a golden stream may carry foldOptions { forfeitAward }, the award the server folds a forfeit with; the recorder offers it to every prefix fold, the fold-epoch guard reads it as part of the stream's input, and twelve new streams give football, generic, hockey and icehockey each a landed and a withheld award), built against base bb26d10f03 (GF-3 T1 review ledger). Ids are relative to the engine collection ROOT. Run: node scripts/lib/test-parity.mjs --before <before-engine.json>=<base>/packages/engine --after <after-engine.json>=packages/engine --ledger this-file. Collect each side with `vitest run --isolate -t __parity_collect_only__ --reporter=json --outputFile <f>` (--isolate on BOTH sides) from the engine directory, the WHOLE package, DATABASE_URL empty. T2 adds 66 tests (6829 -> 6895 collected: 51 in src/testkit/golden-fold-options.test.ts, 12 in test/fold-epoch-guard.test.ts, 3 in test/fold-epoch-guard-cli.test.ts) and retitles none; it edits the bodies (not the titles) of existing tests that replay committed streams so they offer stream.foldOptions (src/testkit/golden-overlay.test.ts, golden-stats.test.ts, golden-format.test.ts, golden-branches.test.ts, golden-slim.test.ts, golden.test.ts), and the corpora, schema snapshots and GOLDEN-POLICY.md they read.
